transcript:
A Regular meeting of the City Council.

Austin Tex November 01, 1886.
Hon. J. N. Roberts on, Mayor, presiding.

Roll Call. Present- Aldermen Brush,
Crooker, Jones, Schuber, Walker, Wellmer and Wortham- 9.
Absent- Aldermen Anderson, Caldwell, Cummings
Dedress, Ervin, Giesen, Holman, Metz,
Odell, Pillow and Schneider- 11.
adjourned On motion, the Council adjourned until the next regular meeting.
Milton Morris
City Clerk.
